Ed Calderon joins Joe Rogan for episode 1408 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Calderon is a former Mexican police officer who worked the cartel wars at close range. He now teaches the skills of survival in that world.

Calderon tells what the border war looks like from a squad car and a safe house. He shares how cartels run towns, buy cops, and move their goods. Rogan asks what the US crowd gets most wrong about the war. Listeners get a grave, first hand tour. The library keeps the episode as a record of his stated account.
